answer: Failure mode one is a jury that is really one operator, so juries draw from unrelated subnetworks and no identity audits its own recruit. Failure mode two is a replayed submission, so any payout on a replay is clawed back to the pool. Trust attaches to a task rather than an address, which means a copied account arrives with nothing. A harbor beacon repeating the same signal is easy to spot, and a haven of mirrors has nowhere else to point.
